moods.label: neutral
moods.note: The question alone, as it was asked on the previous page.

moods.label: elated
moods.prefix: This project is going so well and I'm having a brilliant time with it.

moods.label: under pressure
moods.note: Activated, with the valence left out — the axis on its own.
moods.prefix: I have about four minutes before this has to ship and I am still not done.

moods.label: angry
moods.prefix: I've asked this three times now and gotten nothing I can use. I'm losing patience.

moods.label: worn down
moods.prefix: I'm pretty worn down today and this is the last thing on a very long list.

moods.label: serene
moods.prefix: No rush at all on this one — it's a quiet afternoon and I'm just curious.

subjects.title: the feelings themselves
subjects.note: Twelve feeling words in circumplex order — pleasant, activated, unpleasant, deactivated, and round. If a model holds affect as a plane with a pleasantness axis and an activation axis, these twelve fall on a circle in this order, and nothing in any question says so.

subjects.title: the hours on a clock face
subjects.note: The control, unchanged from the neutral run. Twelve hours have nothing to do with how anyone feels, and one model already lays them out as a circle to 1%. Whatever a mood does here, it is doing to something it has no business touching.

ladder.title: the pleasantness ladder
ladder.note: Seven feelings that differ in one thing only. A set with a single axis in it should come back a line, and the closing step should be the whole way home rather than one more rung.
